Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000992": On 2025-12-31, the Atlas team observed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, marketing send)
- memory_id "1000976": On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it.  (about: Atlas team, reports pipeline, retention change)
- memory_id "1000968" [decision]: As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, having taken it over from the Cinder team.  (about: Atlas team, product catalog, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000966": As of the 2025-12-19 handover, the product catalog's dashboards and alerts are being repointed.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000962" [decision]: On 2025-12-19, the Atlas team took over the product catalog from the Cinder team.  (about: Atlas team, product catalog, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000956" [decision]: On 2025-12-18, the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.  (about: Atlas team, indexer, index)
- memory_id "1000867" [constraint]: The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, during the peak season.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000811": On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer, marketing send)
- memory_id "1000793" [constraint]: As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000775": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000668" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC slot no longer applies.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000666" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be deployed on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000615": Tomasz was on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03, but left it on 2025-07-30 when he moved to the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000604": Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30, when on-call passed from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000594": On 2025-07-30, on-call for the Atlas team passed from Tomasz to Priya Raman when Tomasz moved to the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000501": On 2025-06-19, Priya Raman handed the Atlas team pager to Tomasz on rotation day.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000354" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000351" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000339": The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000158": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
